title: CharIni
description: Parsed shape of a character's char.ini asset file (not a wire packet). char.ini is INI text; this schema describes the normalized object a parser emits. The INI text grammar, the [emote <name>] block convention, and the legacy [emotions]/[soundn]/[soundt] fallback are specified in assets/README.md. Emotes are normalized to one shape for 2D and 3D; `anim` is a sprite stem for 2D characters and a base VMD stem for 3D characters (a character is 3D when options.model is set).

emotes.description: Emote table in button order, normalized from either [emote <name>] blocks or the legacy [emotions] banks.

sections.description: Every raw section, section/key names lowercased, values verbatim. Fallback for blocks this schema does not model (shouts, [Time], frame effects).

Options.description: The [options] block. Common keys are typed; the rest stay on the index. `model` (a .pmx file) marks the character as 3D.

side.description: Court position (e.g. def/pro/wit). Defaults to `wit` when the file has no `side` key.

blips.description: Blip (typing sound) set. Defaults to `male` when the file has no `blips` key; falls back to the obsolete `gender` key when present. `gender` is the legacy predecessor of `blips` and is not modelled here (it remains readable via additional properties).

chat.description: Chat/blip category, or null when the file has no `chat` key (distinct from an explicit empty `chat =`).

category.description: Emote/preanim category, or null when the file has no `category` key (distinct from an explicit empty `category =`).

model.description: PMX model file for a 3D character; absent/empty for 2D.

Emote.description: One normalized emote. The same shape covers 2D and 3D; which optional fields matter depends on the character mode.

key.description: Stable string identity; by default the animation file name. The block name for [emote <name>] characters; the stringified id for legacy characters.

name.description: Display label shown on the emote button.

anim.description: Animation reference. In legacy banks this is a stem the client expands (2D: (a)<anim>/(b)<anim> sprite frames; 3D: base loop VMD). In [emote <name>] blocks it is the full animation filename, extension required (.gif/.webp/.png 2D, .vmd 3D).

preanim.description: Pre-animation, or null when none (`-` in the file). Legacy: a stem. In [emote <name>] blocks: the full filename with extension (as `anim`).

postanim.description: Exit animation ([emote <name>] blocks only; full filename with extension, as `anim`), or null. Plays during a gated preanim phase: when a message enables preanim (a preanim-playing emote modifier), the client plays the leaving emote's postanim, then the entering emote's preanim, then its loop; when preanim is off, neither plays. Exception: on a same-character emote switch (character already on its idle loop) where the leaving emote has a postanim and the entering emote has a preanim, the transition plays regardless of the toggle. Legacy banks have no postanim (always null).

camera.description: Camera-motion file for 3D emotes ([emote <name>] blocks only): a `.vmd` carrying a camera track that frames this emote, or null for the default camera. Legacy banks have no camera (always null).

modifier.description: AO emote modifier (0 = none, 1 = play preanim, 5 = zoom, 6 = objection+zoom). For 3D the zoom variants are advisory; camera treatment comes from the emote's `camera` VMD.

deskmod.description: Desk modifier. Default 1 (shown) when the file omits it.

sound.description: Sound effect for this emote, or null. Legacy [soundn] is a stem the client expands; in [emote <name>] blocks it is the full filename with extension (.opus/.wav/.ogg).

sounddelayms.description: Sound delay in milliseconds. Default 0 when the file omits it. Legacy [soundt] is in ticks (1 tick = 60 ms) and is normalized here.
